blocks.text: FAQs

blocks.q: Is Capital District Cannabis & Wellness a licensed New York dispensary?
blocks.a: Yes. Capital District Cannabis & Wellness is fully licensed by New York State to sell adult-use cannabis. That means every product we carry is sourced from state-regulated cultivators and manufacturers and meets New York’s testing and compliance standards.
blocks.html: Yes. Capital District Cannabis & Wellness is fully licensed by New York State to sell adult-use cannabis. That means every product we carry is sourced from state-regulated cultivators and manufacturers and meets New York’s testing and compliance standards.

blocks.q: What are the benefits of buying from a licensed New York dispensary versus unlicensed shops?
blocks.a: Licensed dispensaries are the only places where you can buy cannabis that has been lab-tested, tracked, and approved under New York’s regulatory system. This ensures accurate potency labeling, contaminant testing, and safe manufacturing practices. Unlicensed dispensaries are not regulated and may sell products of unknown origin or safety.
blocks.html: Licensed dispensaries are the only places where you can buy cannabis that has been lab-tested, tracked, and approved under New York’s regulatory system. This ensures accurate potency labeling, contaminant testing, and safe manufacturing practices. Unlicensed dispensaries are not regulated and may sell products of unknown origin or safety.

blocks.q: What types of cannabis products can I buy in New York?
blocks.a: New York’s legal cannabis market offers a wide range of options to choose from, including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vape cartridges, concentrates, tinctures, beverages, and topicals. All products sold in licensed dispensaries are lab-tested for potency and safety, giving weed shoppers a consistent and reliable experience.

All products sold in licensed dispensaries are lab-tested for potency and safety, giving weed shoppers a consistent and reliable experience.

blocks.q: Is recreational cannabis legal in New York, and what do I need to shop?
blocks.a: Yes. Adults 21 and older can legally purchase recreational cannabis anywhere in New York State. You’ll need a valid government-issued ID—state-issued or out-of-state—to confirm your age before shopping.

blocks.q: Do I have to be a NY resident to buy cannabis?
blocks.a: No. You do not need to live in New York to buy cannabis here. Any adult 21 or older—whether visiting from another state or traveling through Upstate NY—can legally purchase products at licensed dispensaries.

blocks.q: How much cannabis can adults purchase per day in New York State?
blocks.a: New York allows adults to purchase up to: 3 ounces of flower , and 24 grams of concentrates (including vape oils and dabs) per transaction. These limits apply statewide and are the same across all licensed dispensaries.

post.html:
Concert tickets in the Capital Region are an investment, and a little planning makes that investment pay off. Live music rewards preparation: knowing the venue, sizing up the crowd, and pairing the night with the right cannabis for live music can turn a good show into a great one. 

At Capital District Cannabis, we spend a lot of time matching products to moments, and a concert is one of the more fun moments to plan around. Here is our local guide to picking the right strain for three of the area’s favorite stages, Saratoga Performing Arts Center, MVP Arena, and Empire Live, plus a few picks to have on hand no matter the show. All recommendations are for adults 21 and older, and responsible use starts well before the opening act.

Choosing a Complementary Strain for Your Show 

Venue matters, and the genre on stage matters just as much. Matching your pick to the music is one of the simplest ways to land on the best cannabis strains for concerts, no matter where your seat is.

  • If live jazz is your genre of choice, keep a sativa hybrid on hand with relaxed, cerebral effects.
  • Rock music pairs well with a sativa strain, especially one carrying earthy, funky terpenes.
  • Classical music fans tend to enjoy a balanced hybrid with bright, lively terpenes.

7 Concert-Ready Strain Picks

This selection covers weed for concerts of nearly every kind, and each pick below ranks among our best strains for concerts this season.

Saratoga Performing Arts Center, or SPAC, is an open-air amphitheater set on the grounds of Saratoga Spa State Park. The venue seats 5,200 music lovers and hosts concerts across nearly every genre, from a relaxed outdoor evening to a lively, festival-style crowd.

Recommended strains:

  • MFNY Super Lemon Haze x Super Lemon Haze Live Resin Infused Pre-rolls are a sativa strain with 27% THC and a notable terpene profile. With four in a pack, it’s easy to share with friends before heading off to SPAC.
  • Cheech and Chong Legends Edible Mango is a great sativa option for anyone who prefers not to smoke. Edibles take longer to kick in, so plan on enjoying these about an hour before leaving. The bright mango flavor pairs with an uplifting, cerebral high that lasts through the show.

Located in Albany, MVP Arena is a configurable indoor arena that holds anywhere from 6,000 to 17,000 people. Smaller than a stadium, it’s still a mid-sized arena capable of hosting many nationally touring artists.

Recommended strains:

  • Breakfast Connections Trainwreck Blunt is a solid choice to prep for an evening at MVP Arena. With 26% THC and a terpene profile where beta caryophyllene takes the lead, it’s built to complement any event on the calendar.
  • Ayrloom Half +Half Singles is an upgraded take on an Arnold Palmer. It takes a little time to set in, but once it does, it stays with you for the whole night.

Empire Live is a modern, adaptable space that holds up to 1,000 people. It’s designed for good sightlines from most areas, with two hospitality stations on hand for patron comfort. This intimate, social setting calls for a balanced hybrid strain with bright terpenes.

Recommended strains:

  • Ruby Farms Limoncello “Classics” Pre-rolls have nearly 21% THC and bright, citrusy terpenes. They bring a classy, easygoing feel.
  • Ayrloom Blueberry Lavender “Pillow Talk” suits nights built around Led Zeppelin just as well as evenings spent unwinding to Mozart piano concertos.
  • High Peaks Margarita Can makes a far better pre-show sip than a traditional margarita on your way to Empire Live. The entourage effect is at work here, with balanced cannabinoid and terpene profiles built to leave you relaxed yet attentive.

post.html:
Looking for something to help you mellow at the end of the day? Edibles can be an excellent cannabis format for the evening, and there are plenty of options to suit your flavor preferences and goals. 

We’re breaking down how edibles work, what you need to know about choosing the right product, and showing you which evening edibles are the most popular in Albany, Schenectady, and Clifton Park. 

How Edibles Differ From Other Formats for Evening Use

Edibles work differently from smoking or vaping because they have to pass through your digestive system before you’ll start to feel the effects. That means they can take longer to kick in, but the effects also typically last longer once they arrive. 

A slow build can be a big part of the appeal. You can take an edible after dinner and relax on the sofa. By the time the effects have fully developed, you are generally ready to get to sleep. Edibles are discreet, easy to dose, and simple to work into a nighttime routine.

Don’t assume that just because you aren’t feeling the effects, the edible isn’t working. It may just take a little longer. If you take more too soon, you could have a more intense experience than you intended. 

Top Picks for Sleep & Relaxation

These are some of the products currently in high demand for sleepy or relaxing effects: 

  • Cannabals Blueberry Dreams Brick: A blueberry-flavored indica edible with THC and CBN, scored into easy-to-dose pieces. 
  • Wana Quick Island Punch Indica Gummies: Bright, tropical gummies with a fast-acting format with 30+ terpenes.
  • REMZzz Restful Raspberry Sleep Gummies: Raspberry gummies with 20mg each of THC, CBN, and CBD, evenly dosed for easy intake. 
  • Grön Dark Chocolate: Rich dark chocolate for shoppers who want their nighttime edible to feel like dessert. 
  • Off Hours Grape Punch Offline Gummies: Grape gummies with a strong cannabinoid blend for an unplugged evening. 
  • Grön Dark Chocolate with Vanilla Bean Sea Salt: Balanced chocolate option finished with vanilla bean sea salt. 
  • Upstate Elevator Supply Company Chill Tropical Sunrise Gummy: Tropical gummy with low-dose THC and higher CBD content for a gentler approach to the evening.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long do edibles take to work?

Edibles can take 45 minutes to 2 hours to fully kick in. Some fast-acting products are designed for a shorter onset window, so read the label and give yourself plenty of time before deciding to take more. 

What should I do if the effects feel too strong? 

Stay calm, rest somewhere comfortable and quiet, and sip on some water. Strong edible effects will pass with time, and the more comfortable and calm you remain, the better you’ll feel. If you accidentally ingest edibles or feel unsafe, contact Poison Control or emergency services. 

How should I store leftover edibles? 

Keep edibles in their original packaging, clearly labeled, and store them out of reach of children and pets. Edibles can look like regular snacks, so secure storage is a must. Always read the packaging for more storage information (such as if refrigeration is recommended). 

What are the best strains for stress? Or the best cannabis strains for relaxation?

Many people looking for a mellow evening option tend to gravitate toward indica or indica-leaning strains. Classic relaxing weed strains include Granddaddy Purple, Northern Lights, and Wedding Cake. When it comes to edibles, though, the calming cannabis strains are only part of the overall picture. Cannabinoids like THC, CBD, and CBN also help shape the experience. 

A Note on Dosing

The best advice is the one you’ll hear again and again in the cannabis world: start low, go slow. 

When trying the best strains for anxiety and stress, start at the lowest recommended dose and then give yourself plenty of time to feel the full onset. Avoid stacking additional servings until you know how the product affects you, and don’t assume one product will produce the same results as another. Different strains, formats, and formulations can affect you differently.

What Makes a Great THC Vape Cart?

A quality THC vape cart has a few factors that set it apart:

Potency isn’t everything. Look for carts with full-spectrum or strain-specific terpene profiles that use clean extraction methods like live resin or distillate paired with terpenes derived from cannabis. These terpenes have a major impact on the flavor and effects, so brands that preserve them well have products with a taste and effects that more closely match the strain.

Hardware matters as well. THC oil is thick and can clog vape carts easily. Brands that have airflow control and preheating systems make it easier to prevent clogging or remedy it should it occur. Ceramic coils heat the oil more evenly than older wick-based designs, reducing the burnt notes that can come from inferior coils.

Finally, pay attention to the lab tests. Every product sold in a New York dispensary must pass testing for pesticides, heavy metals, residual solvents, and microbial contaminants. The lab tests will show you exactly what’s in the cart.

post.title: Cannabis Concentrates 101: What to Know, How to Use Them, and Where to Buy at Capital District Cannabis
post.html:
Cannabis concentrates can look a little intimidating the first time you shop for them. Wax, shatter, rosin, resin…it’s a lot of names for a category that’s actually pretty easy to understand once it’s explained.

That’s exactly what our cannabis concentrates guide is here to do. Let’s compare cannabis concentrates for beginners, answer your questions, and help you shop for the best cannabis concentrates at any of our NY dispensary locations. 

What Are Cannabis Concentrates?

Cannabis concentrates are made by extracting cannabinoids, terpenes, and other compounds from the cannabis plant. Concentrates ditch the plant matter and put what’s left into a more concentrated form. 

A lot of cannabis consumers choose cannabis extracts because they are more potent than flower and very rich in flavor, thanks to how the terpenes are preserved. Cannabis concentrate effects can be more intense with smaller amounts of product, too. One of the best things about concentrates is how versatile they are. You can smoke them or add them to your flower to boost the potency of your joint or bowl. 

Types of Concentrates: A Breakdown

It’s time for Weed Concentrates 101. When you shop the shelves for concentrates, you’ll see a lot of different types available. The names tell you about the texture of the concentrate as well as how it was produced. The most common THC concentrate types include: 

  • Wax: A soft, sticky cannabis concentrate with a scoopable texture.
  • Shatter: A firm, glass-like extract that can snap or break into pieces.
  • Badder: A whipped concentrate with a smooth, batter-like consistency.
  • Live resin: A concentrate made from fresh-frozen cannabis, often known for strong aroma and terpene preservation.
  • Live rosin: A solventless concentrate made with heat and pressure, often chosen by shoppers who care about plant-forward flavor.
  • Distillate: A refined cannabis oil commonly found in vape carts and infused cannabis products.
  • Hash: A classic concentrate made from collected trichomes, usually pressed or shaped into a workable form.

How to Smoke and Use Concentrates

Wondering how to smoke concentrates? There are a few methods, but not every method works for every product. If you aren’t sure what goes together, talk to one of our friendly budtenders for advice. 

Options for using concentrates include: 

  • Dab rig: A glass setup used to vaporize a small amount of concentrate on a heated surface. 
  • E-rig: The electronic version of a dab rig controls the heat without a torch. 
  • Dab pen: Portable device designed for small amounts of wax, badder, or similar concentrates. 
  • Vape cart: A cartridge filled with cannabis oil, usually paired with a battery.

THC concentrates can be strong, so pay attention to potency. Check the label, talk to the budtenders, and always start low and slow when learning how to use concentrates.

Rosin vs. Wax vs. Live Resin vs. Shatter: How to Choose

The wax vs shatter comparison comes down to two things: texture and handling. Wax is softer and easier to scoop. Shatter is harder and more brittle. Both can be potent. 

Live resin vs rosin is more about how the product is made. Live resin is usually made with solvents and fresh frozen cannabis, which preserves the terpenes of the plant. Rosin is solventless, using heat and pressure to create the concentrate instead. Both can have strong flavor and aroma, but rosin is often priced at a premium because of the process used to make it. 

So which cannabis concentrate products are best? It really depends. Some people care more about the flavor, some want the potency. You might prefer a specific texture depending on how you are using it, or you might need to stick to a certain price point. Talking to our budtenders can help you narrow down your options and find the right fit.

  3. Mind Melters — Cold Cure Live Rosin OG Kush (75.81% THC)
  4. Nyce — Papaya Mimosa Live Hash Rosin Concentrate (70.63% THC)
  5. House of Sacci — Trop Cherry Hash (64.87% THC)

How Does Dispensary Delivery Work in Albany, NY?

July 10 is when the cannabis concentrate community comes out! It’s the category-specific retail moment built around oils, extracts, and vape products, and Capital District Cannabis across all locations makes it worth planning around. Here’s what the day is about and how to make the most of your 710 shopping run.

What Is 710 Day?

“710” flipped upside down reads “OIL.” It’s shorthand for cannabis concentrates and oil-based extracts. The term circulated in online concentrate communities in the early 2010s as dabbing culture developed its own vocabulary: BHO, live resin, dab rigs, and the extraction formats that defined a rapidly growing product category. The holiday emerged organically from those communities and has since been adopted across dispensary marketing calendars nationally.

Where 4/20 celebrates cannabis broadly, 710 focuses on: vape cartridges, cannabis oils, live resin, rosin, wax, badder, shatter, and disposable vapes. It’s the day concentrate consumers plan their premium purchases around.

What Types of Concentrates Go on Sale for 710?

The extract category runs from approachable to artisanal. 

Wax and badder are the accessible ends, two textures at similar price points that are easy to portion and use without much setup. Wax has a drier, crumblier consistency. Badder folds and spreads like a smooth paste. 

Distillate goes a step further in processing, refining cannabis oil until only isolated cannabinoids remain at high, consistent potency. It’s terpene-light by design, built for consumers who prioritize clean, predictable effects over nuanced flavor. 

Vape cartridges are typically distillate-based and are the category’s most grab-and-go option, requiring nothing more than a compatible battery and a quick inhale. 

Live resin preserves the terpene profile of fresh-frozen plant material through solvent extraction, making it the flavor benchmark of the mid-to-upper tier and the first real taste of what cannabis can smell and taste like at its peak. 

Live rosin skips the solvents entirely. Heat, pressure, and ice water produce a concentrate prized for its extraction purity and unmatched by anything below it on the price spectrum.

July 10 Cannabis Deals

We’re gearing up for an awesome 710 Day celebration. Our full lineup of deals and specials will be announced soon.

Check back shortly to see the exclusive 710 dispensary deals in New York, product drops, and in-store promotions we’ll be offering.

In the meantime, browse our menu or visit us in-store to explore our current selection.

Top Concentrate Picks for Dab Day at Capital District Cannabis

  1. Jetpacks Jealousy Diamonds: Crystal-clear THCA diamonds showcasing Jealousy’s sweet, earthy flavor profile and deeply relaxing yet balanced effects.
  2. House of Sacci Trop Cherry Hash: This potent hash delivers rich flavor and fast-acting effects, making it a standout option for experienced concentrate enthusiasts.
  3. High Falls Canna OG Kush Sugar: A terpene-rich sugar concentrate that captures the classic OG Kush profile in a flavorful, high-potency format.
  4. MFNY White Fire Live Resin Badder: Crafted from fresh-frozen flower, this live resin badder combines sour citrus, earthy diesel notes, and an uplifting cerebral experience.
  5. Waferz Runtz Live Resin Badder: A smooth and flavorful live resin badder featuring the sweet, candy-like character that made Runtz a modern favorite.
  6. Hudson Cannabis NYC Diesel Diamonds: These solventless THCA diamonds deliver classic NYC Diesel flavors of citrus and fuel alongside energetic, creative effects.
  7. Jetpacks Yellow Z Diamonds: Bright tropical fruit and candy-like sweetness shine through in these potent sativa-forward diamonds.
  8. NYCE Rosin Jar Jealousy x Soap: This solventless rosin blend pairs bold flavor with a balanced hybrid experience and impressive terpene content.
  9. High Falls Canna NY OG Kush Cured Resin: A powerful cured resin concentrate that highlights the earthy, pungent character of OG Kush with every dab.
  10. Vireo Health RSO Sativa Syringe: This full-spectrum RSO offers a versatile, potent cannabis extract that preserves a broad range of cannabinoids and terpenes.

How to Get the Most Out of a Dispensary 710 Sale

A few practical notes for making your 710 shopping run count:

  1. Compare concentrate types before committing.

Live resin for terpene-rich flavor, distillate for potency and consistency, rosin for solventless preference.

  1. Check unit pricing.

Cost per gram or per milligram of THC equivalent lets you compare across formats and price points. Bundle pricing on 710 often makes the higher-tier options accessible. The Capital District loyalty program lets you earn points on every purchase that can be redeemed for exclusive discounts, product perks, and members-only highlights.

  1. Plan ahead.

710 inventory in popular concentrate categories moves quickly during promotions. Shopping a day or two before July 10th gives you full selection access. 

  1. Store concentrates in a cool, dark environment.

Heat and light degrade both potency and terpene content faster than with flower.

Celebrate Dab Day with Capital District Cannabis

710 Day only comes around once a year, and the deals on the shelf right now won’t last past it. Stop by any Capital District location today, talk to the team, and walk out with something worth celebrating. This is the day the concentrate category was made for, and there’s no better place to spend it.

blocks.text: 3 Reasons Cannabis Feels Different in Winter
If you’ve found your winter cannabis use a little unpredictable or even disappointing, it may be impacted by one (or more) of these three common causes.

blocks.text: 1. Shorter Days and Mood Shifts
The “winter blues” are not just in your head. They’re in your body. Changes in light exposure can impact sleep cycles, energy levels, and overall mood.
blocks.html: The “winter blues” are not just in your head. They’re in your body. Changes in light exposure can impact sleep cycles, energy levels, and overall mood.

blocks.text: When your baseline mood or energy shifts, your cannabis experience may feel different, too. Sometimes more sedating, sometimes less uplifting than expected.

blocks.text: 2. Dry Indoor Air and Hydration

When you’re outside on a hot, sunny day, you’re likely reaching for a cool drink often. When it’s chilly, you may not be hydrating quite so often. On top of that, indoor heating often dries out the air, just as we’re spending more time stuck inside. Cold-weather dehydration can be easy to overlook, and the consequences can include headaches, irritability, and a rapid heart rate. A humidifier and a handy water bottle can go a long way toward replenishment.

post.title: Cold Weather Cannabis: Why Your Winter Sessions Hit Different in Upstate NY

image.alt: Close up of a ripe blooming female marijuana flower with visible trichomes of THC. Shallow depth of field and blurred background.

post.html:
Have you noticed cannabis hitting a bit differently in the colder months? Winter tends to shift our habits and routines in subtle ways, and those shifts can change how the effects land.

Shop Now

3 Reasons Cannabis Feels Different in Winter

If you’ve found your winter cannabis use a little unpredictable or even disappointing, it may be impacted by one (or more) of these three common causes.

1. Shorter Days and Mood Shifts

The “winter blues” are not just in your head. They’re in your body. Changes in light exposure can impact sleep cycles, energy levels, and overall mood.

When your baseline mood or energy shifts, your cannabis experience may feel different, too. Sometimes more sedating, sometimes less uplifting than expected.

2. Dry Indoor Air and Hydration

When you’re outside on a hot, sunny day, you’re likely reaching for a cool drink often. When it’s chilly, you may not be hydrating quite so often. On top of that, indoor heating often dries out the air, just as we’re spending more time stuck inside. Cold-weather dehydration can be easy to overlook, and the consequences can include headaches, irritability, and a rapid heart rate. A humidifier and a handy water bottle can go a long way toward replenishment. 

3. More “Night-In” Sessions

Summer sessions often happen outdoors or socially. Winter tends to mean more evenings at home. A strain that feels energizing at a backyard gathering may feel introspective or heavy during a quiet night alone.

Winter-Friendly Product Types

If you’re looking for winter-friendly cannabis products that will have you feeling relaxed in the evening or balanced for your snow day tasks, here are some of our top picks.

Cozy Edibles

  • Gron Blackberry Mega Sleepy Indica Gummies: Natural fruit flavors and a 1:1 blend of CBN and THC will have your cozy nights in feeling like a dream. 
  • Ayrloom Orange Pomegranate Sol Burst Gummies: Why not handle the winter doldrums with a touch of sun? This hybrid option offers balanced focus. 
  • Canna Dots Unflavored Sublingual Dissolvables: Drop these unflavored hybrid dissolvables into any hot or cold drink for a fast-acting buzz. 
  • Wyld Pomegranate Hybrid Gummies: This balanced strain gives both a mind and body high that provides steady energy that’s perfect for yoga or snow day housekeeping.
  • MFNY Cherry Lime x Super Runtz Live Resin Gummies: A terpene-rich indica strain, these gummies will leave you feeling sleepy and relaxed for an evening in. 
  • Dragonfly Green Apple Gummies: These gummies are sweet and smooth and offer a balanced high that’s a complement for just about whatever your day brings.

Evening Flower Picks

  • CAM Guava Gelato OG: Tropical and citrus notes mix in this indica strain to provide relaxation for the mind and body. 
  • Knack Diesel Kush Cake Flower: This is a potent strain, so be prepared for deep sleep and powerful relaxation. 
  • Doobie Labs Blue Lobster: With a quick activation time, this indica strain can have you catching some ZZZ’s before your head even hits the pillow. 
  • Electraleaf New York Permanent Marker Flower: A unique mix of sweetness with bold diesel makes this indica-forward hybrid a standout. 
  • DayZed Private Party Flower: A mix of sweet, sour, and gassy tastes will leave you with a balanced high that’s great for a mellow winter day.
  • Electraleaf New York Biscotti Flower: If you’re looking for a slow-burning hybrid with a balanced buzz, this is a great strain. 

Convenient Vapes

  • Ayrloom Mood Rest: Rest easy with this harmonious blend of earthy and floral aromatic notes.
  • Jaunty Blackberry Kush AIO Palm: Available in a convenient all-in-one vape, this indica option is potent and mixes berry and diesel flavor notes. 
  • Florist Farms Gorilla Glue AIO Vape: Earthy with pine and citrus notes, this indica choice will have you feeling relaxed and sleepy. 
  • Dragonfly Papaya Punch 510 Cart: A terpene-heavy flavor underpins this indica-forward hybrid that is known for its relaxing and happy effects.
  • Naka Apple Dream 510 Cart: Fruity notes are a major draw for this indica-forward hybrid that leaves you feeling calm but not stoned. 
  • Ayrloom Pink Rozay AIO: These floral notes provide a touch of sophistication and elegance to a balanced, calming high. 

(Just remember to keep your vapes stored indoors and in an upright position. It’s especially important not to leave them in your car during cold weather!)

Using Cannabis as a Mindful Alternative

There is a growing interest in sober-curious cannabis. That means you are curious about the benefits of alcohol sobriety and want to use cannabis to change the experience of a night out. Products like THC beverages are ideal for this, offering a cannabis mocktail–style option that gives you something to sip on during social events without getting the heavy effects of alcohol. The lighter, more predictable dose is easier to navigate than the harsh effects of alcohol.  CBD is another option to explore. Instead of producing a noticeable high, CBD creates a calmer baseline that can help you unwind after work or settle into an evening routine without reaching for a beer or wine. For anyone exploring an alcohol-free lifestyle, CBD is a tool for relaxation without intoxication.  The goal of a cannabis-friendly approach isn’t to swap one overindulgence with another. It’s about mindful cannabis consumption, where you carefully choose products that support your intentions instead of relying on alcohol. 

Building a Dry January Plan With Cannabis

Want to participate in Dry January? Start by thinking about why you want to participate and what you want to get out of the experience. Do you want to sleep better? Experience less anxiety on a night out? When you can answer that question, it’s easy to choose products that can support your goals.  When creating your Dry January plan with cannabis, remember to:

  • Track your results. Pay attention to the timing and dosage of your THC to see what products work best for you in different situations.

Use Dry January weed as a tool to support a reset and create a fresh start for your new year.

  • Generic AF Sparkling Wine Gummies: Alcohol-free fun in a pack big enough to share with the whole crew. 
  • Cannabals Pina Colada Brick: An easy-to-portion brick so you can create the right dose for every situation. 

Balanced Flower

If you want to replace the ritual of drinking with the ritual of smoking, flower is the way forward. Balanced strains help you walk the line between mellow and social. Choose strains such as:

blocks.text: What Makes a Cannabis Deal Truly Valuable?

Most cannabis deals start with a headline: a percent off, a buy-one-get-one special, or a new customer bonus. The biggest number isn’t always the best choice, though. When you look closer, value depends on more than the sticker price. Some factors to consider include:

Spotting a cannabis deal is only half the story when shopping at a dispensary. The real art comes in figuring out whether the promotion actually delivers value, or if it’s just a flashy way to move inventory. In Albany, Schenectady, and Clifton Park, dispensary deals come in many forms: from advertised price drops to loyalty rewards, bundle offers, and limited-time sales. Here’s how to navigate those discounts so you get more out of each visit, without getting sidetracked by numbers alone.

What Makes a Cannabis Deal Truly Valuable?

Most cannabis deals start with a headline: a percent off, a buy-one-get-one special, or a new customer bonus. The biggest number isn’t always the best choice, though. When you look closer, value depends on more than the sticker price. Some factors to consider include:

  • Product quality: A lower price on something you enjoy and trust is worth more than an even deeper discount on a brand you don’t know or haven’t liked before.
  • Freshness: Flower and concentrates can lose strength or flavor over time. Check package dates, especially on marked-down products.
  • Potency: Read product labels to see if the THC or CBD content makes sense for how you plan to use it.
  • Brand reputation: Promotions often feature new, local, or smaller brands alongside recognized names. Sometimes it’s a great way to try something different, but it can pay to do a quick check on the producer or look for reviews before you buy.
  • Overall value: Factor in quantity, not just price. An ounce on sale might be a stronger deal for some than individual pre-roll discounts, depending on your needs and storage habits.

post.title: Infused vs Non-Infused Pre-Rolls: What’s the Difference—and Which Should You Choose?

image.alt: Pre-Rolls Cannabis Joints and dried flower marijuana on a clear background

post.html:
Pre-rolls are one of the most convenient ways to enjoy cannabis, but not all pre-rolls are created equal. When you look at a menu or browse your local dispensary, chances are that the biggest difference you’ll see comes down to whether a joint is infused or not.

Understanding how infused and non-infused options differ can help you choose a product that fits your tolerance, your plans, and the kind of experience you want. Whether you’re browsing pre-rolls in Albany, NY, or comparing options across the region, consider this your breakdown of what sets these two categories apart.

What Is a Non-Infused Pre-Roll?

Let’s start with the classic. As the name suggests, non-infused pre-rolls are most similar to a hand-rolled joint, without any added ingredients.

More specifically, a non-infused pre-roll is made entirely from ground cannabis flower. There are no added concentrates, oils, or kief. What you’re smoking is the same flower you’d find in a jar, just pre-ground and rolled for convenience. This makes non-infused pre-rolls the most straightforward and traditional option on the menu.

Who Are Non-Infused Pre-Rolls Best For?

Non-infused pre-rolls are a solid choice for newer consumers, casual users, or anyone who prefers a lighter, more predictable experience. They’re also popular for daytime use or social settings where you want to stay clear-headed. Many shoppers looking for the best pre-rolls in New York still gravitate toward well-made non-infused options because consistency and flavor come through the most clearly.

What Makes a Pre-Roll “Infused”?

The counterpart to non-infused pre-rolls, infused pre-rolls have a little something extra. That extra typically adds to the experience, but knowing just what you consume is crucial.

More specifically, an infused pre-roll includes cannabis concentrates such as oil, live resin, distillate, or kief that have been added to the flower. Some are mixed throughout the joint, while others are coated or dusted. This is what defines many infused pre-rolls in NY and sets them apart visually and chemically from standard joints. In fact, added concentrates significantly increase the total cannabinoid content compared to flower alone.

Why Infused Pre-Roll Effects Can Feel Stronger

Because concentrates are much more potent than flower, infused pre-rolls often deliver stronger and faster effects. This is why comparing infused joints vs regular joints matters. Even experienced consumers can be surprised if they underestimate the difference, especially with newer infusion methods.

Infused vs Regular: A Quick Decision Matrix

There is no “better” choice when it comes to infused joints vs. regular flower. Instead, it’s about finding the right option for your needs:

  • Potency and tolerance: Infused pre-rolls are designed for higher tolerance levels, while regular pre-rolls offer a more gradual experience that’s easier to control. This distinction is a key factor when choosing between the options in a dispensary that carries both.
  • Price and value: Infused pre-rolls typically cost more due to added concentrates. Non-infused pre-rolls, on the other hand, tend to be more budget-friendly and are often included in daily specials or multipacks. If you’re comparing weed discounts or bulk pricing, non-infused joints can stretch your budget further.
  • Flavor and smoothness: Non-infused pre-rolls showcase the natural terpene profile of the flower. Infused pre-rolls can deliver bolder flavors, but they may burn hotter depending on the infusion method. Burn quality varies by brand and construction.
  • Burn consistency: Well-rolled non-infused joints usually burn more evenly. Infused joints can canoe or burn unevenly if not rolled properly. Asking a budtender which brands are known for consistency can make a noticeable difference.

How Your Use Case Can Influence Your Choice

Beyond the general variables above, the way you plan to smoke your joint can also help to make the right product decision: 

  • Social hangs: For group settings or casual sessions, non-infused pre-rolls are often the better choice. They’re easier to pace, easier to share, and less likely to overwhelm guests. If you’re looking to buy dispensary pre-rolls in Schenectady for your next social occasion, standard joints may be best.
  • Night sessions for experienced users: If you have a higher tolerance and are planning a relaxed evening at home, infused pre-rolls can offer a more intense, longer-lasting experience. This is where infused options tend to shine, especially for consumers who already know their limits.

Always start slowly to understand the product’s strength and effect on your own body.

Lake George launches fireworks directly from a barge in the southern basin. The crowds gather along Shepard Park beach, and the Lake George Steamboat Fireworks Cruise is an experience unto itself. Sailing the Adirondack waters aboard the historic Minne Ha-Ha paddlewheeler with a water-level view of the show. Bolton Landing hosts its own all-day festival at Rogers Memorial Park.

Other notable events: the Fireworks Over Boldt Castle in Alexandria Bay launch from Heart Island over the historic St. Lawrence River fortress. Symphoria Lakeside at Emerson Park on Owasco Lake brings the full Syracuse Symphoria orchestra lakeside for a patriotic concert. And Walkway Over the Hudson in Poughkeepsie offers a 212-foot elevated perspective over the mid-Hudson valley fireworks.

For adult-friendly evening options in Albany, the Official Albany 4th of July Bar Crawl through the Lark Street entertainment district starts at Bar Vegan at 5:00 PM with holiday drink specials. Goose performs with moe. at Albany Med Health System at SPAC.

A summer concert at SPAC is rarely just about the show itself. It’s the long drive up, the tailgate snacks, the lawn chairs, the warm air after sunset, and the feeling of settling in before the first song starts. With so many major artists coming through this year, pairing the right cannabis product with the right concert can make the experience feel even better.

What’s New at SPAC for Summer 2026?

The lineup for Saratoga Performing Arts Center is stacked with big-name tours, nostalgic favorites, country headliners, and jam-band staples. Early in the season, fans can catch CAKE, Jelly Roll, Riley Green, Evanescence, and the Saratoga Jazz Festival, along with performances like BalletX: The Four Seasons Reimagined and Claypool Gold. 

Many of the most anticipated shows are already listed on the official calendar, including Dave Matthews Band, James Taylor, Pitbull, Guns N’ Roses, TOTO, and Luke Bryan. The season also includes New York City Ballet performances, orchestra programming, culinary events, and anniversary celebrations tied to SPAC’s 60th season, giving visitors far more than just concerts to build a weekend around.

Why Cannabis and Concerts Are the Perfect Match

Cannabis has become a more familiar part of the live music experience, especially as legal markets continue to grow and concertgoers become more intentional about how they set the tone for the night. For some, it is about easing into the crowd. For others, it is about enhancing the atmosphere, settling into the music, or matching the mood of a particular show.

The best choice often depends on the artist, the audience, and the pace of the evening. A country concert may call for something mellow and easygoing, while a rock show or dance-heavy lineup may lean better with something brighter and more uplifting.

In New York, adults 21 and older may legally purchase and possess recreational cannabis, but public consumption is still restricted. That means any use should happen before arriving, at home, or in another permitted location, not inside the venue.

Top Cannabis Strains for Different Concert Vibes

Upbeat concerts often work well with citrus-forward sativas and lively hybrids. Sour Diesel, Green Crack, and Super Lemon Haze are some of the most popular picks for louder rock shows, dance-heavy sets, and all-day events.

For something slower and gentler, indica strains like Granddaddy Purple, Northern Lights, or Ice Cream Cake are ideal for acoustic sets, orchestra nights, and lawn seating, where the goal is simply to relax.

Hybrid strains are often the safest middle ground for festivals or longer concerts. Blue Dream, Gelato, and Wedding Cake can bring a more balanced effect that feels social without becoming too heavy too early.

Best Pre-Rolls and Discreet Products for SPAC Events

If you are searching for the best weed for concerts NY has to offer, sativa and hybrid pre-rolls are usually a strong place to start, especially for louder sets, high-energy crowds, and long evenings on the lawn. Pre-rolls tend to be uplifting, balanced, and not overly heavy. Moreover, they are portable, low-maintenance, and easy to work into the hours leading up to the show without much preparation.

At Capital District Cannabis, pre-rolls for concerts that NY shoppers often prefer include Supernaturals New York’s Blue Dream, Florette’s Cap Junky Mini, MFNY’s Candy Rain Live Resin Infused, and Dank by Definition’s Skywalker OG. These give shoppers a mix of classic, infused, and multi-pack formats to choose from before heading north to SPAC. 

Lower-profile formats also have their place, especially before larger events. Gummies, low-dose drinks, and vape pens are all common choices for those interested in discreet cannabis for concerts, particularly when convenience matters as much as effect. 

Planning Your Concert Day: Cannabis Dos and Don’ts

Concert days usually go better with a little planning. Bring water, sunscreen, a portable charger, a blanket or lawn chair if allowed, and enough time to avoid rushing through traffic or parking.

Avoid overconsuming too early, especially if the concert lasts several hours. It’s usually better to start low and build gradually rather than peak before the headliner even starts.

It also helps to leave anything unnecessary at home. Glass pieces, oversized bags, and strong-smelling products can create problems at security or make the experience less comfortable for everyone nearby.

Where to Buy: Capital District Cannabis Locations Near SPAC

Capital District Cannabis & Wellness has locations in Albany, Clifton Park, and Schenectady, all within driving distance of Saratoga Springs and SPAC. Our menu includes flower, edibles, vaporizers, concentrates, and pre-rolls suited to different types of concerts and personal preferences.

For anyone heading north toward Saratoga, Clifton Park is often the easiest stop along the way. Albany and Schenectady locations are also convenient, depending on where you are coming from before the show.

Ready for the Show? Your Cannabis Checklist for SPAC 2026

The best concert nights usually come down to a few essentials: tickets ready, weather checked, comfortable shoes, and a cannabis choice that matches the show’s atmosphere. 

Stick with something familiar, start low, and give yourself time before taking more. Before your next SPAC event, stop by Capital District Cannabis & Wellness and pick up something that fits the music, the venue, and the pace of the evening.

THC drinks are changing the way people across the Capital Region enjoy social occasions without alcohol. Gen Z is less likely to drink for a number of reasons, including maintaining generally healthier lifestyles and increased mental health awareness.

What Are THC Drinks?

THC drinks are beverages that contain cannabis, including cannabinoids designed to dissolve in liquid. While brownies, chocolates, and gummies can take between 30 and 90 minutes to deliver their impact, cannabis beverages can set in much faster, with some people reporting results within 15 to 20 minutes. For many people, that makes them much more desirable for social occasions. 

THC drinks are available in several of your favorite beverage forms, including sparkling beverages, tea, soda, and lemonade. Both low-dose and high-dose options are available, so you can choose the one that best fits your preferences. 

THC Drinks in Albany and Beyond

Make sure you’re choosing licensed, legal sellers, so you can feel confident that you have selected a regulated cannabis beverage made of high-quality cannabis and other ingredients.

Ayrloom: With popular flavors like Cranberry Apple and Half + Half (half tea, half lemonade), Ayrloom has plenty of options to appeal to any palate. This brand is known for decades of craft beverage expertise. 

High Peaks: Whether you’re checking out the Cherry Cola flavor or drinking Frescanna, a grapefruit-inspired soda blend, High Peaks delivers on quality and expectations. 

Layup: Check out Layup’s Ice Tea Lemonade, enjoy their Limeade Infused Beverage for summer, or check out a variety of other lemonade and tea-inspired flavors.

Tips to Enjoy THC Beverages

Getting the most out of a cannabis beverage starts with a little planning, and a lot of patience with yourself. Unlike a cocktail that hits quickly and predictably, THC beverages interact with each person’s body chemistry differently. The more intentional you are about how you dose and pace yourself, the better your experience is likely to be!

1. Start low and go slow

This is the most consistent piece of guidance from cannabis professionals, and it holds especially true for beverages. Begin with a low-dose option, ideally one containing 2.5 to 5 mg of THC per serving, and give your body adequate time to register the effects before consuming more. 

Even at lower doses, the onset can take anywhere from 15 to 45 minutes, depending on your metabolism, what you’ve eaten, and your individual tolerance. Resist the urge to have a second serving too quickly. 

2. Understand the dose tiers

Cannabis beverages come in a range of potencies, and knowing the difference helps you shop smarter. Microdoses typically between 1 and 2 mg per serving are well-suited for those who want a barely-there mood lift without any noticeable impairment. Low doses in the 2.5 to 5 mg range tend to work well for beginners or anyone easing back into cannabis after a break. 

Standard doses of 10 mg or more are best reserved for experienced consumers who already have a solid sense of their tolerance. There is no universal right dose. Only the one that fits your body and your evening.

3. Consider what you’ve eaten

Food in your system can meaningfully slow how your body absorbs a cannabis beverage. A full meal before you sip may soften the onset and extend the duration of effects. An empty stomach may produce a faster, stronger response. Neither outcome is inherently better, but being aware of it helps you make a more informed decision about when and how much to consume.

4. Keep it simple and don’t mix

Avoid combining THC beverages with alcohol. The two interact in ways that can be difficult to predict, and layering them can quickly tip a pleasant evening in an unwelcome direction. If you are already enjoying a cannabis beverage, set the alcohol aside for the night. This is one of the clearest boundaries you can set for yourself to keep the experience enjoyable.

5. Check in with yourself

Pace yourself, take breaks, and pay attention to subtle shifts in mood or energy. If you feel like the effects are building quickly, find a comfortable place to sit, hydrate, and give your body time to level out. Cannabis beverages are meant to complement a good time. When you approach them with a little awareness and preparation, they can be a genuinely enjoyable alternative for social occasions and quiet evenings.

post.title: Vapes 101: Live Resin vs. Live Rosin vs. Distillate

image.alt: Vape pen isolated up close. Full gram cartridge of cannabis oil. Alternative method of smoking the THC extracted from marijuana plants.

post.html:
The oil inside a vape shapes nearly everything that follows, from the first note of flavor to the price at checkout. Live resin, live rosin, and distillate each bring a different balance of flavor, potency, and price, all of which matter when deciding how to choose the right cannabis strain.

What Is a Live Resin Vape?

Live resin is made for shoppers who want cannabis flavor to remain unmistakably present. Freshly harvested flower is frozen before extraction, preserving aromatic compounds that can fade during traditional drying and curing.

The result is often vivid and expressive, with profiles that move through citrus peel, ripe fruit, fresh herbs, earth, or fuel. Live resin typically sits between distillate and rosin in price, offering a richer, more cultivar-driven experience without reaching the highest end of the vape menu.

What Is a Live Rosin Vape?

Live rosin takes a more artisanal route. Fresh-frozen cannabis is washed in ice water, refined into hash, then pressed using heat and pressure, without chemical solvents.

Its appeal lies in texture and nuance rather than polish alone. A well-made rosin vape can feel remarkably close to flower, carrying small aromatic details that make each cultivar distinct.

Extraction method does not dictate the entire experience, however. Choosing cannabis based on effects also means looking at cannabinoid content, terpene profile, potency, tolerance, and the setting in which the product will be enjoyed.

What Is a Distillate Vape?

Distillate favors precision. The oil is extensively refined to concentrate cannabinoids and create a clean, consistent base, with terpenes often added afterward to shape the flavor.

That flexibility gives distillate vapes their wide range, from familiar cultivar profiles to bright fruit, candy, and dessert-inspired options. While a cannabis strain guide may help narrow the menu, the cannabinoid blend and terpene source often say more than the name alone.

Comparing Flavor, Potency, and Price

Live resin is the flavor-led middle ground, expressive and terpene-rich without automatically carrying a luxury price.

Live rosin is the connoisseur’s edit, defined by solventless production, smaller yields, and a more intimate expression of the plant.

Distillate is direct, consistent, and often more accessible, with broad flavor variety and cannabinoid concentration taking priority over preserving the original flower profile.

The best cannabis strain for beginners is not necessarily the mildest-sounding name on the menu. Clear potency information, dependable hardware, and a flavor that feels approachable are often more useful than relying on indica, sativa, or hybrid alone.

Which Vape Type Should You Choose?

Let your priorities lead. Live resin is the natural fit when fresh cannabis flavor and terpene detail matter most. Live rosin offers the most artisanal route, with solventless extraction and a premium, close-to-flower finish. Distillate keeps the experience direct, consistent, and often more accessible in price.

The same thinking applies to how to choose a weed strain: look beyond the name and compare the oil, potency, terpene profile, hardware, and setting you have in mind.

The most compelling vape is not necessarily the most expensive or potent, but the one that reflects what you value most, whether that is the vivid voice of live resin, the finesse of solventless rosin, or the clean versatility of distillate.

The fun at the 2025 Altamont County Fair is set to begin soon! From August 12 – 17th, this annual event will be filled with the best food, entertainment, attractions, and exhibits in Altamont. While the exhibits and vendors may close at 10 PM, you can keep the good times rolling with us at Capital District Cannabis. Stop by our dispensary near Altament Fairgrounds, or place an online order for pickup before your fun-filled day to grab the perfect post-fair cannabis pairings.

Cannabis for Summer Fairs

Edibles to Satisfy Your Sweet Tooth

If the funnel cakes and fried Oreos weren’t enough to cure your sweet tooth, indulge in some of our edibles to end the night.

The ZONK! Strawberry Crunch Chocolate Bar is made with decadent white chocolate, strawberry flavoring, and crunchy puffed rice. It carries a total of 100mg of THC across 10 individual servings so that you can enjoy a balanced high solo or at a chill hangout with friends.

Crack open a High Peaks infused drink for a refreshing post-fair treat. Try their Strawberry Lemonade flavor for a tangy and sweet 10mg of THC and 5mg of CBD. This drink contains no sugar, calories, or carbs, making it the perfect option for those seeking a guilt-free treat!

Vape Carts for a Relaxing Post-Fair Wind Down

If you’re a fan of smokables but don’t want the fuss of a pre-roll, our vapes are a discreet alternative to a post-fair high.

The Fernway Berry Haze Traveler vape is a sleek and discreet indica vape. Its sweet berry flavor with earthy undertones delivers a deeply relaxing high, perfect to close out your jam-packed day.

PAX High Purity THC London Pound Cake vape is guaranteed to relax your body and your mind. This indica vape has a creamy vanilla taste with citrusy lemon notes. Made from ocean-bound plastic, this compact yet powerful vape is ideal for on-the-go adventures.

Pre-Rolls for the Perfect Nightcap

After a long day of navigating the carnival crowds and lines, chill out with some of our packed pre-rolls.

High Falls Canna pre-rolls offer a smooth smoking experience from start to finish. The Sativa Blend pre-rolls provide a happy and balanced high at a price you just can’t beat. Grab one (or two) of these pre-rolls next time you stop by our shop.

Leal pre-rolls bring you back to basics with a simple, dependable, packed pre-roll. Their Nic the Bruiser is a delicious indica-hybrid that will give you a relaxing body high and a happy and clear mind. 

How to Order Weed Near Altamont Fair

To make the very best out of your day at the Altamont County Fair, we recommend you grab your favorite products from our dispensary before you make your way to the fairgrounds. For a quick and easy trip, place your order online for pickup in our store. Make sure to bring your ID and enjoy your fresh cannabis responsibly!

post.title: Your Local Guide to Buying CBD Products in Albany & Schenectady, NY
post.html:
Curious about CBD but not sure where to start? We can help. CBD, or cannabidiol, has become a go-to option for many people thanks to its versatility and mellow nature. From simple CBD tinctures to CBD gummies, there is a formula and format to fit everyone’s routine. If you are wondering where to buy CBD, this guide will break down the basics so you can shop for a high-quality product that fits your needs.

Shop CBD

CBD Types Explained: From Whole Plant to THC-Free

When you browse a CBD menu, you’ll see a lot of unfamiliar terms. Most of them have to do with how much of the hemp plant’s original profile is retained in the final product. 

Here’s what you need to know: 

  • Full spectrum CBD: Think “whole plant.” Full-spectrum products include CBD along with minor cannabinoids and natural hemp terpenes. They also contain trace THC from hemp-derived CBD (no more than 0.3%). Many shoppers choose full-spectrum products for a more rounded experience that feels true to the original plant. 
  • Broad spectrum CBD: This is similar to full spectrum, but minus the THC. You still get CBD plus the supporting cannabinoids and terpenes, but it’s marketed as THC-free CBD.
  • CBD isolate: Pure CBD, refined to remove other cannabinoids and terpenes. Isolate is flavor-neutral and easy to dose. It’s popular for unflavored CBD oils, capsules, and certain topicals that rely on consistency. 

Which product is best? It depends on your personal preferences. Our team can help you compare options side-by-side to find the best CBD products in NY for your routine and goals. 

The Benefits of CBD Oils and Tinctures for Everyday Wellness

CBD oils and CBD tinctures are the most flexible ways to incorporate CBD into your daily routine. You can use them by: 

  • Placing them under the tongue. Put the suggested dose beneath your tongue, hold it there for a few seconds, then swallow. Many customers like this method as it’s an easy-to-follow routine they can do almost anywhere. 
  • Mixing them with a beverage. You can add these unflavored products to smoothies, herbal teas, or even your morning coffee. 
  • Micro-dosing them. Use the dropper’s markings to take a small, consistent amount and adjust as needed. 

Fans of oils love the simple ingredients and portability. If you are new to CBD, a tincture with a clear milligram mark per serving can make tracking your dosing experiences simple. 

CBD Edibles and Gummies for Pre-Portioned Relief

CBD gummies are popular for two big reasons: taste and convenience. They come pre-portioned, often with 5-25 mg per piece, so it’s easy to know exactly how much you’re taking. 

Many shoppers looking for natural CBD relief for travel anxiety or an evening wind down keep gummies on hand because they are discreet and require zero prep. You’ll find different versions, including sugar-free and vegan options. Ask our team about our assorted packs, which allow you to try different strengths and flavors. 

CBD Topicals for Muscles and Joints 

If you need pain relief, this is the one for you. CBD topicals are designed for on-the-spot application. Many customers reach for them after a workout, during long days at their desks, or as a part of their nightly ritual. 

Look for labels that note the CBD content, the amount per application, and other ingredients. Since topicals are applied directly to the skin, they are ideal for targeted use when you want to avoid ingesting cannabinoids altogether. 

How to Choose Quality CBD in the Capital Region

No matter where you shop, whether it’s Albany, Schenectady, or anywhere nearby, focus on a few basics to find high-quality CBD. Look for recent third-party lab results (COAs) that confirm potency and support THC-free CBD claims for broad-spectrum and isolate varieties. 

Labels should clearly state total milligrams and be transparent about their sourcing and extraction methods. Pay attention to the other ingredients in the product as well. Topicals should have skin-friendly ingredients like shea butter or aloe, and gummies should use your preferred sweeteners and flavors. 

Always shop with a credible local CBD shop that can educate you on products and help you find the right one. A knowledgeable team at a CBD store in the Capital Region can help you compare options and choose something that suits your lifestyle. 

Visit Our Dispensary for Trusted CBD Options

If you’d like to try CBD, stop by and speak with our team at Capital District Cannabis and Wellness. We keep a rotating lineup of the best CBD products in NY, offering everything from pre-rolls to gummies to beverages and more. 

We’ll guide you through the various options and help you find a product that best suits your preferences and needs. We serve the entire Capital Region with high-quality CBD and friendly, no-pressure guidance. Ask your questions, share your goals, and we’ll ensure you leave with a product you are excited to try. Visit us today!
